cohort: Pregnant women and newborns in Kenya
finding: While the initial four months of the COVID-19 pandemic did not show significant differences in overall RMNCAH service utilization in Kenya, there were concerning increases in caesarean section rates, adolescent maternal deaths, and fresh stillbirths, alongside shifts in family planning preferences.
mod_finding: Caesarean section rates increased significantly from 14.6% to 15.8% during the initial four months of the COVID-19 pandemic compared to the same period in the previous year.
